atrial_flutter.why: Often indicates more complex atrial substrate and longer ablation/EP time.

septal_defect_or_shunt.why: Congenital septal defects/shunts can add anatomic complexity and access challenges.

valve_repair_or_prosthesis.why: Prior valve surgery/prosthesis is associated with altered anatomy and longer procedures.

prior_ligation_or_maze.why: Prior surgical atrial procedures often make mapping/ablation more difficult.

device_lead_revision_or_extraction_histo.why: Prior device/lead problems predict more complex implant or revision workflows.

venous_occlusion_or_stenosis.why: Venous obstruction can prolong access, lead work, and device procedures.

left_atrial_appendage_thrombus_or_sponta.why: Thrombus or dense SEC often requires extra imaging, anticoagulation management, or case deferral.

frailty_or_deconditioning.why: Frailty/deconditioning can increase setup, anesthesia, and recovery complexity.
